description: A Lightning JS component implementing a shopping cart panel with dynamic entry rendering, theme integration, state management via cartStore, and transition effects.

classes.name: CartPanel
classes.description: A Lightning JS component representing a shopping cart panel with items display, subtotal, and checkout confirmation overlay.

methods.name: $rowY
methods.description: Calculates the y-coordinate for a row based on its index.

methods.name: $formatPrice
methods.description: Formats a price number as a string with two decimal places and a dollar sign.

methods.name: $formatTotal
methods.description: Calculates and formats the total price for a given item price and quantity.

methods.name: $inc
methods.description: Increments the quantity of a cart item.

methods.name: $dec
methods.description: Decrements the quantity of a cart item.

methods.name: $remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart.

methods.name: $clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: $checkout
methods.description: Handles the checkout process, showing a confirmation overlay.

methods.name: $closeConfirm
methods.description: Closes the order confirmation overlay with a transition.
